results.title: Volatility-Optimized RSI Mean Reversion Trading Strategy | by FMZQuant | Medium
results.snippet: This strategy primarily identifies high-probability reversal opportunities when RSI reaches extreme levels (RSI≤30 for oversold, RSI≥70 for overbought), but only trades when market conditions favor mean reversion strategies.

claims_extracted: RSI extreme levels (RSI≤30 oversold, RSI≥70 overbought) identify potential mean reversion opportunities
Volatility conditions are used as a filter to select only high-probability reversal setups when market conditions favor mean reversion
The strategy combines a momentum oscillator (RSI) with a volatility filter to avoid false signals during non-mean-reverting regimes
limitations: Medium blog post, not peer-reviewed research
No backtest or out-of-sample validation provided
Author is a quantitative trading platform, potential promotional bias
No specific instrument or timeframe details given
disconfirming_relevance: May not generalize across all FTMO instruments
Volatility filter methodology not precisely defined
RSI parameters may be overfitted to specific market conditions
